rationale.conceptual: The method combines waveguide mode analysis, quasi-BIC physics, Pockels effect modulation, and critical coupling optimization. While individual simulation steps (eigenfrequency, DC electrostatic, frequency-domain scattering) are standard in the field, correctly implementing the electro-optic coupling and extracting modulation metrics requires substantial domain knowledge and careful translation of the paper's multi-physics setup.

Orchestration involves handling material data from literature, setting up a unit-cell geometry, and coordinating solvers; this forms a multi-stage pipeline (~4 steps) of moderate complexity.
